```text
# AI Mock Technical Interviewer — Plan (HackRU '26)

## Context
We're building a web app for practicing coding interviews. The candidate:
- picks a topic and difficulty, **or pastes in their own custom question**
- picks an interviewer voice and tone
- solves a problem in a code editor while a voice interviewer talks with them, asks the occasional probing question and gives hints when asked
- gets a scored review at the end

Optional extras: a session recording, and Presage-based feedback on presence and composure.

**Stack:**
- Next.js (App Router) + TypeScript, Tailwind
- **LLM:** Gemini (`@google/genai`, Gemini Flash for low latency)
- **Voice:** ElevenLabs. TTS for the interviewer, Scribe for the candidate's speech-to-text.
- **VAD:** `@ricky0123/vad-web` (Silero VAD in the browser)
- **Editor:** Monaco

**No code execution.** The code is never run. Gemini reads the code and reasons about its correctness, edge cases and complexity, the way a human interviewer does when the candidate traces through examples.

## User flow
1. **Setup page** (`/`)
   - A toggle picks the question source: **Topic** or **Custom question**.
   - *Topic mode:* topic chips (Two Pointers, Sliding Window, DP, Graphs, Binary Search, Trees, Heap, Backtracking, and "Other" with free text) plus a difficulty of Easy, Medium or Hard.
   - *Custom question mode:* paste your own question, or pick one you saved before from "My questions". See [Custom questions](#custom-questions).
   - Language: Python, JS, Java or C++. This only sets the editor syntax highlighting and the starter code.
   - Interviewer: an ElevenLabs voice picker with a preview button, plus a tone of Friendly, Neutral or Tough (FAANG-style).
   - Pressing "Start" asks for mic permission.
2. **Overview**: the interviewer introduces itself, gives an AI overview of the format ("45 min, one problem, think out loud, ask clarifying questions") and then reads the problem.
3. **Interview room** (`/interview/[id]`)
   - Left: problem statement and examples.
   - Center: Monaco editor with a **"I'm done"** button.
   - Right: live transcript, a VAD status indicator (listening / you're speaking / interviewer speaking), an **"Can I get a hint?"** button and a timer.
   - **The mic is always on. There is no toggle and no push-to-talk.** VAD finds the speech segments.
4. **Review page** (`/review/[id]`): scorecard, transcript and final code.

## Voice pipeline (always-on mic + VAD)
- Use `getUserMedia` with `echoCancellation`, `noiseSuppression` and `autoGainControl` turned on, so the interviewer's TTS isn't picked up as candidate speech.
- `MicVAD` (vad-web) runs for the whole interview:
  - `onSpeechStart` marks the candidate as talking. If the interviewer is mid-sentence, stop TTS playback (barge-in) so the candidate can interrupt naturally.
  - `onSpeechEnd(audio)` encodes the Float32 segment to WAV and POSTs it to `/api/stt` (ElevenLabs Scribe). The transcript text is appended to the live transcript.
- **Echo guard:** while the interviewer audio is playing, ignore VAD segments shorter than about 600ms and raise the speech threshold, so TTS bleed-through doesn't trigger false barge-ins.
- VAD tuning: `positiveSpeechThreshold` about 0.6, `redemptionFrames` set for about 800ms of trailing silence, so short thinking pauses inside a sentence don't split the utterance. `minSpeechFrames` filters out coughs and keyboard clicks.
- Each transcribed utterance goes to the `InterjectionController` as a "candidate spoke" event.

## Core design: throttled interviewer interjections
The interviewer must not nag. A client-side `InterjectionController` decides *when* to call the LLM, and the LLM decides *what* to say.
- **Trigger events:**
  - a candidate utterance ends (it gets an immediate reply if it's a direct question, otherwise it counts as a candidate for a probe)
  - a large code change after 60s or more of stable code
  - the candidate says "done" / "I think that's it", or presses "I'm done"
  - no speech or typing for 3 minutes or more (gentle check-in)
- **Throttles:**
  - minimum **90s cooldown** between unsolicited interjections
  - no interjection while the candidate is typing or talking. The VAD speaking state plus about 8s of typing debounce cover this.
  - at most around 1 interjection per 3–4 minutes on average
  - direct questions from the candidate and hint requests always get a response
- **LLM decision:** each trigger sends `{problem, code snapshot, recent transcript, elapsed time, hints used, tone}` to `/api/interviewer`. Gemini returns JSON `{ speak: boolean, message, kind: "probe"|"answer"|"hint"|"checkin"|"wrapup" }`.
  - Example probes: "Why did you choose a hashmap?", "Is this optimal?", "Are you sure about that edge case?", "Can you walk me through it with this input?"
  - `speak:false` is an expected outcome that lets the candidate keep thinking.
01-getting-started
02-guides
03-api-reference
04-glossary.md
index.md
```

````text
title: Font Module
nav_title: Font
description: Optimizing loading web fonts with the built-in `next/font` loaders.

{/* The content of this doc is shared between the app and pages router. You can use the `<PagesOnly>Content</PagesOnly>` component to add content that is specific to the Pages Router. Any shared content should not be wrapped in a component. */}

[`next/font`](/docs/app/api-reference/components/font) automatically optimizes your fonts (including custom fonts) and removes external network requests for improved privacy and performance.

It includes **built-in automatic self-hosting** for any font file. This means you can optimally load web fonts with no [layout shift](https://web.dev/articles/cls).

You can also conveniently use all [Google Fonts](https://fonts.google.com/). CSS and font files are downloaded at build time and self-hosted with the rest of your static assets. **No requests are sent to Google by the browser.**

<AppOnly>

  )
}
````

```typescript
"use client";

import { useEffect, useRef } from "react";

const CELL_W = 22;
const CELL_H = 28;
const RADIUS = 170;
const ACCENT = "255,180,84";
// Digits are doubled so the field reads as numbers first, code second.
const GLYPHS = "01234567890123456789{}[]()<>=+-*/;:&|!?#_.,%".split("");

const randomGlyph = () => GLYPHS[(Math.random() * GLYPHS.length) | 0];

/**
 * Full-viewport field of dim code glyphs. Glyphs near the cursor light up in the
 * accent colour and fade out behind it; a few random ones also flicker on their own.
 * The dim base layer is drawn once to an offscreen canvas, so each frame only
 * redraws the glyphs that are lit.
 */
export function CodeRain() {
  const canvasRef = useRef<HTMLCanvasElement>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    const canvas = canvasRef.current;
    const ctx = canvas?.getContext("2d");
    if (!canvas || !ctx) return;

    const reduceMotion = window.matchMedia("(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)").matches;
    const base = document.createElement("canvas");
    const baseCtx = base.getContext("2d")!;

    let cols = 0;
    let rows = 0;
    let dpr = 1;
    let glyphs: string[] = [];
    let heat = new Float32Array(0);
    let mouseX = -9999;
    let mouseY = -9999;
    let raf = 0;
    let fontFamily = "ui-monospace, monospace";

    const font = () => `500 14px ${fontFamily}`;

    function layout() {
      dpr = Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio || 1, 2);
      const w = window.innerWidth;
      const h = window.innerHeight;
      cols = Math.ceil(w / CELL_W);
      rows = Math.ceil(h / CELL_H);
      glyphs = Array.from({ length: cols * rows }, randomGlyph);
      heat = new Float32Array(cols * rows);
      for (const c of [canvas!, base]) {
        c.width = w * dpr;
        c.height = h * dpr;
      }
      canvas!.style.width = `${w}px`;
      canvas!.style.height = `${h}px`;
      paintBase();
      if (reduceMotion) frame();
    }

    function paintBase() {
      baseCtx.setTransform(dpr, 0, 0, dpr, 0, 0);
      baseCtx.clearRect(0, 0, base.width, base.height);
      baseCtx.font = font();
      baseCtx.textAlign = "center";
      baseCtx.textBaseline = "middle";
      baseCtx.fillStyle = "rgba(243,240,232,0.075)";
      for (let i = 0; i < glyphs.length; i++) {
        baseCtx.fillText(
          glyphs[i],
          (i % cols) * CELL_W + CELL_W / 2,
          ((i / cols) | 0) * CELL_H + CELL_H / 2,
        );
      }
    }

    function frame() {
      ctx!.setTransform(1, 0, 0, 1, 0, 0);
      ctx!.clearRect(0, 0, canvas!.width, canvas!.height);
      ctx!.drawImage(base, 0, 0);
      ctx!.setTransform(dpr, 0, 0, dpr, 0, 0);
      ctx!.font = font();
      ctx!.textAlign = "center";
      ctx!.textBaseline = "middle";

      if (!reduceMotion) {
        // Ambient flicker, like output scrolling by.
        for (let n = 0; n < 4; n++) {
          const i = (Math.random() * heat.length) | 0;
          heat[i] = Math.max(heat[i], 0.3 + Math.random() * 0.2);
        }
      }

      const r2 = RADIUS * RADIUS;
      for (let i = 0; i < heat.length; i++) {
        const x = (i % cols) * CELL_W + CELL_W / 2;
        const y = ((i / cols) | 0) * CELL_H + CELL_H / 2;
        const dx = x - mouseX;
        const dy = y - mouseY;
        const d2 = dx * dx + dy * dy;
        if (d2 < r2) {
          const t = 1 - d2 / r2;
          if (t * t > heat[i]) heat[i] = t * t;
        }
        if (heat[i] > 0.03) {
          if (heat[i] > 0.55 && Math.random() < 0.06) glyphs[i] = randomGlyph();
          ctx!.fillStyle = `rgba(${ACCENT},${Math.min(1, heat[i] * 1.15).toFixed(3)})`;
          ctx!.fillText(glyphs[i], x, y);
          heat[i] *= 0.93;
        } else {
          heat[i] = 0;
        }
      }
      if (!reduceMotion) raf = requestAnimationFrame(frame);
    }

    const onMove = (e: PointerEvent) => {
      mouseX = e.clientX;
      mouseY = e.clientY;
    };
    const onLeave = () => {
      mouseX = mouseY = -9999;
    };

    const family = getComputedStyle(document.documentElement)
      .getPropertyValue("--font-geist-mono")
      .trim();
    if (family) fontFamily = `${family}, ui-monospace, monospace`;

    layout();
    document.fonts?.ready.then(() => {
      paintBase();
      if (reduceMotion) frame();
    });
    if (!reduceMotion) raf = requestAnimationFrame(frame);

    window.addEventListener("resize", layout);
    window.addEventListener("pointermove", onMove);
    document.addEventListener("pointerleave", onLeave);
    return () => {
      cancelAnimationFrame(raf);
      window.removeEventListener("resize", layout);
      window.removeEventListener("pointermove", onMove);
      document.removeEventListener("pointerleave", onLeave);
    };
  }, []);

  return (
    <canvas
      ref={canvasRef}
      aria-hidden
      className="pointer-events-none fixed inset-0 z-0"
    />
  );
}

```

```typescript
"use client";

import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react";

/** Fades and lifts its children into view the first time they scroll on screen. */
export function Reveal({
  children,
  className = "",
}: {
  children: React.ReactNode;
  className?: string;
}) {
  const ref = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const [shown, setShown] = useState(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    const el = ref.current;
    if (!el) return;
    const io = new IntersectionObserver(
      ([entry]) => {
        if (entry.isIntersecting) {
          setShown(true);
          io.disconnect();
        }
      },
      { threshold: 0.12 },
    );
    io.observe(el);
    return () => io.disconnect();
  }, []);

  return (
    <div ref={ref} data-in={shown} className={`reveal ${className}`}>
      {children}
    </div>
  );
}

```

```typescript
"use client";

import { useEffect, useState } from "react";

export type RailSection = { id: string; label: string };

/**
 * Replaces the native scrollbar: a thin rail on the right edge with a progress
 * fill, one tick per section (click to jump) and a live percentage.
 */
export function ScrollRail({ sections }: { sections: RailSection[] }) {
  const [progress, setProgress] = useState(0);
  const [active, setActive] = useState(0);

  useEffect(() => {
    function onScroll() {
      const max = document.documentElement.scrollHeight - window.innerHeight;
      setProgress(max > 0 ? Math.min(1, window.scrollY / max) : 0);
      const line = window.innerHeight * 0.4;
      let current = 0;
      sections.forEach((s, i) => {
        const el = document.getElementById(s.id);
        if (el && el.getBoundingClientRect().top <= line) current = i;
      });
      setActive(current);
    }
    onScroll();
    window.addEventListener("scroll", onScroll, { passive: true });
    window.addEventListener("resize", onScroll);
    return () => {
      window.removeEventListener("scroll", onScroll);
      window.removeEventListener("resize", onScroll);
    };
  }, [sections]);

  function jump(id: string) {
    document.getElementById(id)?.scrollIntoView({ behavior: "smooth", block: "start" });
  }

  return (
    <nav
      aria-label="Page sections"
      className="fixed right-5 top-1/2 z-30 hidden -translate-y-1/2 items-stretch gap-3 md:flex"
    >
      <ol className="flex flex-col items-end justify-between gap-5 py-1">
        {sections.map((s, i) => (
          <li key={s.id}>
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => jump(s.id)}
              aria-current={i === active ? "true" : undefined}
              className={`group flex items-center gap-2 font-mono text-[11px] uppercase tracking-widest transition-colors ${
                i === active ? "text-accent" : "text-zinc-500 hover:text-zinc-300"
              }`}
            >
              <span
                className={`transition-all ${
                  i === active ? "opacity-100" : "opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100"
                }`}
              >
                {s.label}
              </span>
              <span className="tabular-nums">{String(i).padStart(2, "0")}</span>
            </button>
          </li>
        ))}
      </ol>
      <div className="relative w-px bg-zinc-700/70" aria-hidden>
        <div
          className="absolute left-0 top-0 w-px bg-accent"
          style={{ height: `${progress * 100}%` }}
        />
        <div
          className="absolute -left-[3px] h-[7px] w-[7px] rounded-full bg-accent shadow-[0_0_12px_2px_rgba(255,180,84,0.6)]"
          style={{ top: `calc(${progress * 100}% - 3px)` }}
        />
      </div>
      <span
        className="self-end font-mono text-[11px] tabular-nums text-zinc-500"
        aria-hidden
      >
        {Math.round(progress * 100)}%
      </span>
    </nav>
  );
}
```

```typescript
"use client";

import { useEffect, useState } from "react";

/** Floating bar that appears once you scroll past the hero: your picks + the start button. */
export function SummaryBar({
  items,
  canStart,
  onStart,
}: {
  items: string[];
  canStart: boolean;
  onStart: () => void;
}) {
  const [visible, setVisible] = useState(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    const onScroll = () => setVisible(window.scrollY > window.innerHeight * 0.6);
    onScroll();
    window.addEventListener("scroll", onScroll, { passive: true });
    return () => window.removeEventListener("scroll", onScroll);
  }, []);

  return (
    <div
      className={`fixed inset-x-0 bottom-4 z-40 flex justify-center px-4 transition-all duration-500 ${
        visible ? "translate-y-0 opacity-100" : "pointer-events-none translate-y-6 opacity-0"
      }`}
    >
      <div className="flex w-full max-w-3xl items-center justify-between gap-4 rounded-2xl border border-zinc-700 bg-zinc-950/90 py-2.5 pl-5 pr-2.5 backdrop-blur">
        <p className="truncate font-mono text-xs text-zinc-300 sm:text-sm">
          {items.join(" · ")}
        </p>
        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={onStart}
          disabled={!canStart}
          className="shrink-0 rounded-xl bg-accent px-5 py-2.5 text-sm font-semibold text-zinc-950 transition-all hover:brightness-110 focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:outline-offset-2 focus-visible:outline-accent disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-40"
        >
          Start interview →
        </button>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

```

```typescript
"use client";

import { useMemo, useState } from "react";
import { useRouter } from "next/navigation";
import {
  DIFFICULTIES,
  LANGUAGE_LABELS,
  LANGUAGES,
  TONES,
  TOPICS,
  type Difficulty,
  type Language,
  type Tone,
} from "@/lib/types";
import type { Problem } from "@/lib/types";
import { VOICES } from "@/lib/voices";
import { useSessionStore } from "@/lib/session";
import { useCustomQuestions } from "@/lib/customQuestions";
import { CustomQuestionForm } from "@/components/CustomQuestionForm";
import { ProblemPreview } from "@/components/ProblemPreview";
import { MyQuestionsList } from "@/components/MyQuestionsList";
import { OptionTile } from "./OptionTile";
import { ScrollRail, type RailSection } from "./ScrollRail";
import { StepSection } from "./StepSection";
import { SummaryBar } from "./SummaryBar";

type Source = "topic" | "custom";

/** Drops blank rows left over from editing in the preview. */
function cleanProblem(p: Problem): Problem {
  return {
    ...p,
    constraints: p.constraints.map((c) => c.trim()).filter(Boolean),
    examples: p.examples.filter((ex) => ex.input.trim() || ex.output.trim()),
  };
}

const TONE_DESCRIPTIONS: Record<Tone, string> = {
  Friendly: "Encouraging and patient",
  Neutral: "Professional, keeps it moving",
  Tough: "FAANG-style, pushes back hard",
};

const SOURCES: { value: Source; label: string; description: string }[] = [
  { value: "topic", label: "Pick a topic", description: "We choose the problem" },
  { value: "custom", label: "Custom question", description: "Bring your own" },
];

export function SetupForm() {
  const router = useRouter();
  const createSession = useSessionStore((s) => s.createSession);
  const customQuestions = useCustomQuestions((s) => s.questions);
  const saveQuestion = useCustomQuestions((s) => s.save);
  const removeQuestion = useCustomQuestions((s) => s.remove);

  const [source, setSource] = useState<Source>("topic");
  const [selectedId, setSelectedId] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [showForm, setShowForm] = useState(false);
  const [topic, setTopic] = useState<string>(TOPICS[0]);
  const [customTopic, setCustomTopic] = useState("");
  const [difficulty, setDifficulty] = useState<Difficulty>("Medium");
  const [language, setLanguage] = useState<Language>("python");
  const [voiceId, setVoiceId] = useState(VOICES[0].id);
  const [tone, setTone] = useState<Tone>("Neutral");

  const isOther = topic === "Other";
  const selectedQuestion = customQuestions.find((q) => q.id === selectedId) ?? null;
  const formOpen = showForm || customQuestions.length === 0;
  const canStart =
    source === "custom" ? selectedQuestion !== null : !isOther || customTopic.trim().length > 0;

  function start() {
    if (source === "custom") {
      if (!selectedQuestion) return;
      const problem = cleanProblem(selectedQuestion);
      saveQuestion(problem);
      const id = createSession(
        { topic: problem.topic, difficulty: problem.difficulty, language, voiceId, tone },
        problem,
      );
      router.push(`/interview/${id}`);
      return;
    }
    const id = createSession({
      topic: isOther ? customTopic.trim() : topic,
      difficulty,
      language,
      voiceId,
      tone,
    });
    router.push(`/interview/${id}`);
  }

  // Step numbers and the scroll rail follow whichever steps are on screen.
  const steps = useMemo(
    () => [
      { id: "source", label: "Mode" },
      ...(source === "topic"
        ? [
            { id: "topic", label: "Topic" },
            { id: "difficulty", label: "Level" },
          ]
        : [{ id: "question", label: "Question" }]),
      { id: "language", label: "Language" },
      { id: "voice", label: "Voice" },
      { id: "tone", label: "Tone" },
    ],
    [source],
  );
  const railSections: RailSection[] = [{ id: "top", label: "Intro" }, ...steps];
  const n = (id: string) => steps.findIndex((s) => s.id === id) + 1;

  const summary =
    source === "custom"
      ? [selectedQuestion?.title ?? "No question yet"]
      : [isOther ? customTopic.trim() || "Other" : topic, difficulty];
  summary.push(
    LANGUAGE_LABELS[language],
    VOICES.find((v) => v.id === voiceId)?.name ?? "",
    tone,
  );

  return (
    <div id="setup" className="scroll-mt-4">
      <ScrollRail sections={railSections} />

      <StepSection id="source" index={n("source")} title="Mode" hint="Where should the problem come from?">
        <div className="grid gap-3 sm:grid-cols-2">
          {SOURCES.map((s) => (
            <OptionTile
              key={s.value}
              selected={source === s.value}
              onClick={() => setSource(s.value)}
              title={s.label}
              description={s.description}
            />
          ))}
        </div>
      </StepSection>

      {source === "topic" ? (
        <>
          <StepSection id="topic" index={n("topic")} title="Topic" hint="What do you want to drill?">
            <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3 lg:grid-cols-3">
              {[...TOPICS, "Other"].map((t) => (
                <OptionTile key={t} selected={topic === t} onClick={() => setTopic(t)} title={t} />
              ))}
            </div>
            {isOther && (
              <input
                autoFocus
                value={customTopic}
                onChange={(e) => setCustomTopic(e.target.value)}
                placeholder="e.g. bit manipulation, tries, intervals"
                aria-label="Custom topic"
                className="w-full rounded-xl border border-zinc-700 bg-zinc-900 px-4 py-3 outline-none focus:border-accent"
              />
            )}
          </StepSection>

          <StepSection id="difficulty" index={n("difficulty")} title="Level" hint="How hard should it push?">
            <div className="grid gap-3 sm:grid-cols-3">
              {DIFFICULTIES.map((d) => (
                <OptionTile
                  key={d}
                  selected={difficulty === d}
                  onClick={() => setDifficulty(d)}
                  title={d}
                />
              ))}
            </div>
          </StepSection>
        </>
      ) : (
        <StepSection id="question" index={n("question")} title="Question" hint="Paste one, or reuse a saved one.">
          {formOpen ? (
            <CustomQuestionForm
              onFormatted={(problem) => {
                saveQuestion(problem);
                setSelectedId(problem.id);
                setShowForm(false);
              }}
              onCancel={customQuestions.length > 0 ? () => setShowForm(false) : undefined}
            />
          ) : (
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => setShowForm(true)}
              className="w-full rounded-xl border border-dashed border-zinc-700 py-4 text-zinc-300 transition-colors hover:border-accent hover:text-accent"
            >
              + Add a new question
            </button>
          )}

          {customQuestions.length > 0 && (
            <div className="space-y-3 pt-4">
              <h3 className="font-mono text-xs uppercase tracking-widest text-zinc-400">
                My questions
              </h3>
              <MyQuestionsList
                questions={customQuestions}
                selectedId={selectedId}
                onSelect={setSelectedId}
                onDelete={(id) => {
                  removeQuestion(id);
                  if (id === selectedId) setSelectedId(null);
                }}
              />
            </div>
          )}

          {selectedQuestion && (
            <div className="space-y-3 pt-4">
              <h3 className="font-mono text-xs uppercase tracking-widest text-zinc-400">
                Preview and edit
              </h3>
              <ProblemPreview problem={selectedQuestion} onChange={saveQuestion} />
            </div>
          )}
        </StepSection>
      )}

      <StepSection id="language" index={n("language")} title="Language" hint="Sets the editor and starter code.">
        <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3 lg:grid-cols-4">
          {LANGUAGES.map((l) => (
            <OptionTile
              key={l}
              selected={language === l}
              onClick={() => setLanguage(l)}
              title={LANGUAGE_LABELS[l]}
            />
          ))}
        </div>
      </StepSection>

      <StepSection id="voice" index={n("voice")} title="Voice" hint="Who&apos;s sitting across from you?">
        <div className="grid gap-3 sm:grid-cols-2">
          {VOICES.map((v) => (
            <OptionTile
              key={v.id}
              selected={voiceId === v.id}
              onClick={() => setVoiceId(v.id)}
              title={v.name}
              description={v.description}
              // Voice preview is wired up with ElevenLabs in milestone 3.
              trailing={
                <span className="mt-1 text-xs opacity-60" title="Preview coming soon">
                  ▶
                </span>
              }
            />
          ))}
        </div>
      </StepSection>

      <StepSection id="tone" index={n("tone")} title="Tone" hint="How they treat you.">
        <div className="grid gap-3 sm:grid-cols-3">
          {TONES.map((t) => (
            <OptionTile
              key={t}
              selected={tone === t}
              onClick={() => setTone(t)}
              title={t}
              description={TONE_DESCRIPTIONS[t]}
            />
          ))}
        </div>
      </StepSection>

      {/* Room for the floating bar below the last step. */}
      <div className="h-32" />
      <SummaryBar items={summary} canStart={canStart} onStart={start} />
    </div>
  );
}

```

The first draft is live at localhost:3000. Typecheck and lint pass. I checked the hero and the scroll through to the last step in the browser, but I haven't tried clicking Start or the custom-question mode.

## Your skills
- **ui-ux-pro-max: not installed.**
- **shadcn: not installed.**
- **Design-related skills you do have:** `design:design-critique`, `design:design-system`, `design:accessibility-review`, `design:ux-copy`, `design:design-handoff`, `artifact-design` (only for artifacts), and `clerk-custom-ui` (Clerk component styling only).

I didn't use any of them for this draft. I can run `/design:design-critique` on the result if you want.

## What was wrong
The old page was a plain zinc and emerald form with pill chips. Everything had the same weight, so nothing led the eye.

## What I built
- **Look:** warm near-black, one amber accent, and a serif display font (Instrument Serif) for headlines. The hero line is "Talk it through *before it counts.*"
- **Code in the background:** a full-screen field of dim digits and code symbols. Characters light up amber around your cursor and fade behind it, and a few flicker on their own. It turns the flicker off if your system is set to reduced motion.
- **Scroll wheel:** the native scrollbar is hidden. In its place is a thin rail on the right with an amber progress line and dot, clickable section markers, and a live percentage. It is hidden on phone widths.
- **Same features, restyled:**
  - The same setup choices are now six numbered steps with large tiles: Mode, Topic or Question, Level, Language, Voice and Tone.
  - A floating bar shows your picks and the Start button once you scroll past the hero.
  - The custom-question flow and the session logic are unchanged.
- **Other pages:** I remapped the zinc and emerald colors in the theme, so the editor and review pages pick up the new palette without edits.

## Components
These are in `components/landing/`:
- `CodeRain`
- `ScrollRail`
- `Hero`
- `StepSection`
- `OptionTile`
- `SummaryBar`
- `Reveal`
- `SetupForm`, which holds the logic moved out of the page

```typescript
"use client";

import { useEffect, useRef } from "react";

const AURA_MS = 900;

/**
 * Replaces the system cursor with a small dot. Clicking releases a soft white
 * aura that expands and fades out. Skipped on touch devices, and over text
 * fields the dot hides so the normal text cursor shows.
 */
export function Cursor() {
  const dotRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    const dot = dotRef.current;
    if (!dot || !window.matchMedia("(pointer: fine)").matches) return;

    const reduceMotion = window.matchMedia("(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)").matches;
    document.documentElement.classList.add("custom-cursor");

    let x = -100;
    let y = -100;
    let pressed = false;
    let hovering = false;
    let overText = false;

    function render() {
      const scale = pressed ? 0.7 : hovering ? 2.2 : 1;
      dot!.style.transform = `translate3d(${x}px, ${y}px, 0) translate(-50%, -50%) scale(${scale})`;
      dot!.style.opacity = overText ? "0" : "1";
    }

    const onMove = (e: PointerEvent) => {
      x = e.clientX;
      y = e.clientY;
      const target = e.target as Element | null;
      overText = !!target?.closest("input, textarea");
      hovering = !!target?.closest("button, a, [role='button']");
      render();
    };
    const onDown = (e: PointerEvent) => {
      pressed = true;
      render();
      if (reduceMotion) return;
      const aura = document.createElement("div");
      aura.setAttribute("aria-hidden", "true");
      aura.style.cssText = `position:fixed;left:${e.clientX}px;top:${e.clientY}px;width:90px;height:90px;margin:-45px 0 0 -45px;border-radius:9999px;pointer-events:none;z-index:9998;background:radial-gradient(circle,rgba(255,255,255,0.55) 0%,rgba(255,255,255,0.18) 45%,rgba(255,255,255,0) 70%);box-shadow:0 0 0 1px rgba(255,255,255,0.35)`;
      document.body.appendChild(aura);
      aura
        .animate(
          [
            { transform: "scale(0.2)", opacity: 1 },
            { transform: "scale(1.6)", opacity: 0.55, offset: 0.35 },
            { transform: "scale(2.4)", opacity: 0 },
          ],
          { duration: AURA_MS, easing: "cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.7, 0.2, 1)" },
        )
        .finished.then(() => aura.remove())
        .catch(() => aura.remove());
    };
    const onUp = () => {
      pressed = false;
      render();
    };
    const onLeave = () => {
      x = y = -100;
      render();
    };

    window.addEventListener("pointermove", onMove);
    window.addEventListener("pointerdown", onDown);
    window.addEventListener("pointerup", onUp);
    document.addEventListener("pointerleave", onLeave);
    return () => {
      document.documentElement.classList.remove("custom-cursor");
      window.removeEventListener("pointermove", onMove);
      window.removeEventListener("pointerdown", onDown);
      window.removeEventListener("pointerup", onUp);
      document.removeEventListener("pointerleave", onLeave);
    };
  }, []);

  return (
    <div
      ref={dotRef}
      aria-hidden
      className="pointer-events-none fixed left-0 top-0 z-[9999] h-3 w-3 rounded-full bg-white mix-blend-difference transition-[scale,opacity] duration-150"
      style={{ transform: "translate3d(-100px,-100px,0)" }}
    />
  );
}

```

- **Scope:**
  - **Text fields:** over inputs and textareas the dot hides and the normal text cursor shows, so typing still works.
  - **Touch devices and reduced motion:** touch devices keep their normal behavior. With reduced motion on, you get the dot but no aura.
  - **Other pages:** the dot only exists on this front page. The system cursor returns when you navigate away, so the editor is unaffected.

The new component is `components/landing/Cursor.tsx`. The glow size, brightness and duration are at the top and in the style string in that file. If you want the aura to linger longer or glow more, tell me and I'll adjust.

```typescript
"use client";

import { useEffect, useRef } from "react";

const SIZE = 26;
// Arrow tip inside the 24x24 icon, scaled to SIZE. This is the click point.
const TIP = (4.5 / 24) * SIZE;
// The five sparks around the tip in the icon: up, up-right, up-left, left, down-left.
const RAY_ANGLES = [-90, -45, -135, 180, 135];
const POP_MS = 560;

/** Sparks burst out of the arrow tip at (x, y), then fade. */
function pop(x: number, y: number) {
  const root = document.createElement("div");
  root.setAttribute("aria-hidden", "true");
  root.style.cssText = `position:fixed;left:${x}px;top:${y}px;width:0;height:0;pointer-events:none;z-index:9998`;

  const glow = document.createElement("div");
  glow.style.cssText =
    "position:absolute;left:-40px;top:-40px;width:80px;height:80px;border-radius:9999px;background:radial-gradient(circle,rgba(255,255,255,0.4),rgba(255,255,255,0) 68%)";
  root.appendChild(glow);
  glow.animate(
    [
      { transform: "scale(0.3)", opacity: 1 },
      { transform: "scale(1.5)", opacity: 0 },
    ],
    { duration: POP_MS + 200, easing: "ease-out", fill: "forwards" },
  );

  for (const angle of RAY_ANGLES) {
    const ray = document.createElement("div");
    ray.style.cssText = `position:absolute;left:-1px;top:0;width:2px;height:7px;border-radius:2px;background:#fff;transform-origin:50% 0;transform:rotate(${angle + 90}deg) translateY(10px)`;
    root.appendChild(ray);
    ray.animate(
      [
        { transform: `rotate(${angle + 90}deg) translateY(6px) scaleY(0.3)`, opacity: 1 },
        { transform: `rotate(${angle + 90}deg) translateY(12px) scaleY(1)`, opacity: 1, offset: 0.35 },
        { transform: `rotate(${angle + 90}deg) translateY(24px) scaleY(0.6)`, opacity: 0 },
      ],
      { duration: POP_MS, easing: "cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.7, 0.2, 1)", fill: "forwards" },
    );
  }

  document.body.appendChild(root);
  setTimeout(() => root.remove(), POP_MS + 250);
}

/**
 * Replaces the system cursor with an outlined arrow. Clicking pops sparks out
 * of its tip. Skipped on touch devices; over text fields it hides so the normal
 * text cursor shows.
 *
 * Position lives on the outer element and hover/press scaling on the inner one,
 * pivoting on the tip, so changing state can never move the pointer.
 */
export function Cursor() {
  const posRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const bodyRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    const pos = posRef.current;
    const body = bodyRef.current;
    if (!pos || !body || !window.matchMedia("(pointer: fine)").matches) return;

    const reduceMotion = window.matchMedia("(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)").matches;
    document.documentElement.classList.add("custom-cursor");

    let pressed = false;
    let hovering = false;

    function setState() {
      const scale = pressed ? 0.88 : hovering ? 1.18 : 1;
      body!.style.transform = `scale(${scale}) rotate(${pressed ? -10 : 0}deg)`;
    }

    const onMove = (e: PointerEvent) => {
      pos.style.transform = `translate3d(${e.clientX}px, ${e.clientY}px, 0)`;
      pos.style.opacity = "1";
      const target = e.target instanceof Element ? e.target : null;
      pos.style.visibility = target?.closest("input, textarea") ? "hidden" : "visible";
      const next = !!target?.closest("button, a, [role='button']");
      if (next !== hovering) {
        hovering = next;
        setState();
      }
    };
    const onDown = (e: PointerEvent) => {
      pressed = true;
      setState();
      if (!reduceMotion) pop(e.clientX, e.clientY);
    };
    const onUp = () => {
      pressed = false;
      setState();
    };
    const onLeave = () => {
      pos.style.opacity = "0";
    };

    window.addEventListener("pointermove", onMove);
    window.addEventListener("pointerdown", onDown);
    window.addEventListener("pointerup", onUp);
    document.addEventListener("pointerleave", onLeave);
    return () => {
      document.documentElement.classList.remove("custom-cursor");
      window.removeEventListener("pointermove", onMove);
      window.removeEventListener("pointerdown", onDown);
      window.removeEventListener("pointerup", onUp);
      document.removeEventListener("pointerleave", onLeave);
    };
  }, []);

  return (
    <div
      ref={posRef}
      aria-hidden
      className="pointer-events-none fixed left-0 top-0 z-[9999] opacity-0"
    >
      <div
        ref={bodyRef}
        className="transition-transform duration-150 ease-out"
        style={{
          width: SIZE,
          height: SIZE,
          marginLeft: -TIP,
          marginTop: -TIP,
          transformOrigin: `${TIP}px ${TIP}px`,
        }}
      >
        <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" width={SIZE} height={SIZE} className="drop-shadow-[0_1px_2px_rgba(0,0,0,0.6)]">
          <path
            d="M4.5 4.5 L20.5 9.8 C21.6 10.2 21.5 11.2 20.4 11.5 L14.8 12.8 L12.2 19.8 C11.8 20.9 10.8 20.8 10.4 19.8 Z"
            fill="#0d0d0c"
            stroke="#fff"
            strokeWidth="1.7"
            strokeLinejoin="round"
          />
        </svg>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

```text
import type { Metadata } from "next";
import { DM_Sans, Geist_Mono, Newsreader } from "next/font/google";
import "./globals.css";

// Stand-ins for HackerRank's Kalice (serif headlines) and Satoshi (body).
const newsreader = Newsreader({
  variable: "--font-serif",
  subsets: ["latin"],
  style: ["normal", "italic"],
  axes: ["opsz"],
});

const dmSans = DM_Sans({
  variable: "--font-body",
  subsets: ["latin"],
});

const geistMono = Geist_Mono({
  variable: "--font-geist-mono",
  subsets: ["latin"],
});

export const metadata: Metadata = {
  title: "AI Interview Prep",
  description: "Practice coding interviews with a voice AI interviewer",
};

export default function RootLayout({ children }: LayoutProps<"/">) {
  return (
    <html
      lang="en"
      className={`${dmSans.variable} ${geistMono.variable} ${newsreader.variable} h-full antialiased`}
    >
      <body className="min-h-full flex flex-col">{children}</body>
    </html>
  );
}
```

```typescript
"use client";

import { useEffect, useRef } from "react";

const BARS = 72;
const ACCENT = "255,180,84";
const QUIET = "243,240,232";

/**
 * The interviewer's "presence": a disc ringed by voice bars. The bars surge in
 * the accent colour while `speaking`, and settle to a quiet pulse while listening.
 */
export function VoiceOrb({ speaking, size = 340 }: { speaking: boolean; size?: number }) {
  const canvasRef = useRef<HTMLCanvasElement>(null);
  const speakingRef = useRef(speaking);

  useEffect(() => {
    speakingRef.current = speaking;
  }, [speaking]);

  useEffect(() => {
    const canvas = canvasRef.current;
    const ctx = canvas?.getContext("2d");
    if (!canvas || !ctx) return;

    const reduceMotion = window.matchMedia("(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)").matches;
    const dpr = Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio || 1, 2);
    canvas.width = size * dpr;
    canvas.height = size * dpr;

    const c = size / 2;
    const core = size * 0.17;
    const ring = size * 0.25;
    const reach = size * 0.2;
    let level = speakingRef.current ? 1 : 0;
    let raf = 0;

    function frame(now: number) {
      const t = now / 1000;
      level += ((speakingRef.current ? 1 : 0) - level) * 0.08;

      ctx!.setTransform(dpr, 0, 0, dpr, 0, 0);
      ctx!.clearRect(0, 0, size, size);

      // Soft halo behind everything.
      const halo = ctx!.createRadialGradient(c, c, core * 0.5, c, c, size / 2);
      halo.addColorStop(0, `rgba(${ACCENT},${0.1 + level * 0.16})`);
      halo.addColorStop(1, `rgba(${ACCENT},0)`);
      ctx!.fillStyle = halo;
      ctx!.fillRect(0, 0, size, size);

      ctx!.lineCap = "round";
      ctx!.lineWidth = 2.4;
      for (let i = 0; i < BARS; i++) {
        const a = (i / BARS) * Math.PI * 2 - Math.PI / 2;
        // Layered sines read as a voice without needing real audio.
        const wave =
          Math.sin(t * 5.1 + i * 0.55) * 0.5 +
          Math.sin(t * 8.3 - i * 0.21) * 0.3 +
          Math.sin(t * 2.2 + i * 1.3) * 0.2;
        const voice = Math.abs(wave) * level;
        const idle = (0.5 + 0.5 * Math.sin(t * 1.4 + i * 0.26)) * 0.12 * (1 - level);
        const len = 4 + (voice + idle) * reach;
        const cos = Math.cos(a);
        const sin = Math.sin(a);
        ctx!.strokeStyle =
          level > 0.5
            ? `rgba(${ACCENT},${0.45 + voice * 0.55})`
            : `rgba(${QUIET},${0.28 + idle})`;
        ctx!.beginPath();
        ctx!.moveTo(c + cos * ring, c + sin * ring);
        ctx!.lineTo(c + cos * (ring + len), c + sin * (ring + len));
        ctx!.stroke();
      }

      // Core disc, breathing slightly with the voice.
      const r = core * (1 + level * 0.06 * Math.sin(t * 6));
      const disc = ctx!.createRadialGradient(c - r * 0.3, c - r * 0.35, r * 0.1, c, c, r);
      disc.addColorStop(0, `rgba(255,214,150,${0.35 + level * 0.65})`);
      disc.addColorStop(1, `rgba(${ACCENT},${0.22 + level * 0.78})`);
      ctx!.fillStyle = disc;
      ctx!.beginPath();
      ctx!.arc(c, c, r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx!.fill();
      ctx!.strokeStyle = `rgba(${ACCENT},0.9)`;
      ctx!.lineWidth = 1.2;
      ctx!.stroke();

      if (!reduceMotion) raf = requestAnimationFrame(frame);
    }

    // With reduced motion, draw one representative frame instead of animating.
    raf = requestAnimationFrame(reduceMotion ? () => frame(1300) : frame);
    return () => cancelAnimationFrame(raf);
  }, [size]);

  return (
    <canvas
      ref={canvasRef}
      aria-hidden
      className="max-w-full"
      style={{ width: size, height: size, aspectRatio: "1" }}
    />
  );
}
```

```typescript
"use client";

import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import { VoiceOrb } from "./VoiceOrb";

type Turn = { who: "agent" | "you"; text: string };

// A scripted sample of what a session sounds like. Not a live call.
const SCRIPT: Turn[] = [
  { who: "agent", text: "Before you code, walk me through your approach." },
  { who: "you", text: "I'd keep two pointers and move the smaller side in." },
  { who: "agent", text: "Why two pointers and not a hash map?" },
  { who: "you", text: "The array is sorted, so I can do it in constant space." },
  { who: "agent", text: "Good. Are you sure about the empty-array case?" },
  { who: "you", text: "Hmm. Can I get a hint?" },
  { who: "agent", text: "Check what your loop does when left meets right." },
];

const TYPE_MS = 32;
const HOLD_MS = 1500;

/** Hero centrepiece: the voice orb plus a sample exchange that types itself out. */
export function AgentDemo() {
  const [turn, setTurn] = useState(0);
  const [chars, setChars] = useState(0);

  const current = SCRIPT[turn];
  const previous = turn > 0 ? SCRIPT[turn - 1] : null;
  const typing = chars < current.text.length;

  useEffect(() => {
    if (window.matchMedia("(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)").matches) {
      // No typing or cycling: show the first exchange in full.
      const id = setTimeout(() => {
        setTurn(1);
        setChars(SCRIPT[1].text.length);
      }, 0);
      return () => clearTimeout(id);
    }
    const id = setTimeout(
      () => {
        if (typing) {
          setChars((n) => n + 1);
        } else {
          setTurn((i) => (i + 1) % SCRIPT.length);
          setChars(0);
        }
      },
      typing ? TYPE_MS : HOLD_MS,
    );
    return () => clearTimeout(id);
  }, [turn, chars, typing]);

  const agentSpeaking = current.who === "agent" && typing;

  return (
    <figure className="flex flex-col items-center">
      <div className="relative">
        <VoiceOrb speaking={agentSpeaking} />
        <p className="absolute inset-x-0 bottom-1 flex items-center justify-center gap-2 font-mono text-[11px] uppercase tracking-widest">
          <span
            className={`h-1.5 w-1.5 rounded-full ${
              current.who === "agent" ? "bg-accent" : "bg-zinc-400"
            }`}
          />
          <span className={current.who === "agent" ? "text-accent" : "text-zinc-400"}>
            {current.who === "agent" ? "Interviewer speaking" : "Listening to you"}
          </span>
        </p>
      </div>

      {/* Fixed height so the hero doesn't shift as lines type in. */}
      <div className="mt-6 flex h-36 w-full max-w-sm flex-col justify-end gap-3" aria-hidden>
        {previous && <Line turn={previous} text={previous.text} dim />}
        <Line turn={current} text={current.text.slice(0, chars)} caret={typing} />
      </div>

      <figcaption className="mt-4 font-mono text-[11px] uppercase tracking-widest text-zinc-500">
        Sample exchange
      </figcaption>
    </figure>
  );
}

function Line({
  turn,
  text,
  dim = false,
  caret = false,
}: {
  turn: Turn;
  text: string;
  dim?: boolean;
  caret?: boolean;
}) {
  const agent = turn.who === "agent";
  return (
    <p className={`transition-opacity duration-500 ${dim ? "opacity-40" : ""}`}>
      <span
        className={`block font-mono text-[11px] uppercase tracking-widest ${
          agent ? "text-accent" : "text-zinc-500"
        }`}
      >
        {agent ? "Interviewer" : "You"}
      </span>
      <span className={`text-lg leading-snug ${agent ? "text-zinc-100" : "text-zinc-300"}`}>
        {text}
        {caret && <span className="caret ml-0.5 inline-block h-[1em] w-px translate-y-[0.15em] bg-current" />}
      </span>
    </p>
  );
}
```

_**Agent (claude-opus-5-5 2026-10-10 20:56:34Z)**_

The hero now leads with the interviewer, and the fonts are swapped. I checked both in the browser, and typecheck and lint pass.

## The AI interviewer, front and center
- **Headline:** "Meet your interviewer." with an "AI voice interviewer" label above it, in the same spirit as "Meet Chakra".
- **Voice orb:** an amber disc ringed by voice bars sits beside the headline. The bars surge when the interviewer speaks and settle to a quiet grey pulse while it listens. A status line underneath switches between "Interviewer speaking" and "Listening to you".
- **Sample exchange:** a short scripted conversation types itself out under the orb and loops. The interviewer asks for your approach, challenges it, and gives a hint. It's labelled "Sample exchange" because it's a script, with no real audio.
- **Supporting copy:** one sentence on what it does, a "Start a mock interview" button, and four tags: Listens, Asks why, Gives hints, Scores you.

## Fonts
HackerRank uses Kalice for headlines and Satoshi for body text. Neither is on Google Fonts, and Kalice is a paid font, so I used the closest free matches:

| Role | HackerRank | Used here |
|---|---|---|
| Headlines | Kalice | Newsreader |
| Body and buttons | Satoshi | DM Sans |
| Small labels | (pixel-style logo font) | Geist Mono, unchanged |

Satoshi is a free download from Fontshare; if you want the exact body font, I can self-host it. That adds font files to the repo.

## Things to know
- New components are `VoiceOrb.tsx` and `AgentDemo.tsx` in `components/landing/`. The script lines are a list at the top of `AgentDemo.tsx`.
- Your dev server sometimes serves a stylesheet one edit behind. If the fonts look wrong, re-save `app/globals.css` and refresh.
- I haven't checked the hero at phone width.

```typescript
"use client";

import { useEffect, useRef } from "react";

const RIPPLE = "96,160,228";
// Water layers, back to front: lighter surface water over darker depths.
const LAYERS = [
  "rgba(52,126,204,0.55)",
  "rgba(30,90,164,0.72)",
  "rgba(17,58,116,0.86)",
  "rgba(8,32,70,0.96)",
];

/**
 * The interviewer's "presence": a dark sphere of water. While `speaking` the
 * waves swell and ripples spread outward; while listening the surface is calm.
 */
export function VoiceOrb({ speaking, size = 340 }: { speaking: boolean; size?: number }) {
  const canvasRef = useRef<HTMLCanvasElement>(null);
  const speakingRef = useRef(speaking);

  useEffect(() => {
    speakingRef.current = speaking;
  }, [speaking]);

  useEffect(() => {
    const canvas = canvasRef.current;
    const ctx = canvas?.getContext("2d");
    if (!canvas || !ctx) return;

    const reduceMotion = window.matchMedia("(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)").matches;
    const dpr = Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio || 1, 2);
    canvas.width = size * dpr;
    canvas.height = size * dpr;

    const c = size / 2;
    const R = size * 0.34;
    let level = speakingRef.current ? 1 : 0;
    // Wave phase is accumulated so speeding up while speaking never makes it jump.
    let phase = 0;
    let last = 0;
    let raf = 0;

    function frame(now: number) {
      const dt = last ? Math.min(0.05, (now - last) / 1000) : 0.016;
      last = now;
      level += ((speakingRef.current ? 1 : 0) - level) * 0.07;
      phase += dt * (1 + level * 1.6);

      ctx!.setTransform(dpr, 0, 0, dpr, 0, 0);
      ctx!.clearRect(0, 0, size, size);

      // Deep-water glow behind the sphere.
      const glow = ctx!.createRadialGradient(c, c, R * 0.6, c, c, size / 2);
      glow.addColorStop(0, `rgba(36,104,196,${0.16 + level * 0.14})`);
      glow.addColorStop(1, "rgba(36,104,196,0)");
      ctx!.fillStyle = glow;
      ctx!.fillRect(0, 0, size, size);

      // Ripples spreading out from the sphere.
      for (let k = 0; k < 3; k++) {
        const p = (phase * 0.28 + k / 3) % 1;
        ctx!.strokeStyle = `rgba(${RIPPLE},${(1 - p) * (0.07 + level * 0.3)})`;
        ctx!.lineWidth = 1.2;
        ctx!.beginPath();
        ctx!.arc(c, c, R + 3 + p * (size / 2 - R - 6), 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx!.stroke();
      }

      ctx!.save();
      ctx!.beginPath();
      ctx!.arc(c, c, R, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx!.clip();

      const sky = ctx!.createLinearGradient(0, c - R, 0, c + R);
      sky.addColorStop(0, "#0c2444");
      sky.addColorStop(1, "#040b17");
      ctx!.fillStyle = sky;
      ctx!.fillRect(c - R, c - R, R * 2, R * 2);

      LAYERS.forEach((fill, j) => {
        const baseY = c + R * (-0.12 + j * 0.24);
        const amp = R * (0.03 + level * (0.17 - j * 0.03));
        const k = 0.02 * (1 + j * 0.32);
        const speed = 1.5 + j * 0.45;
        ctx!.beginPath();
        ctx!.moveTo(c - R, c + R);
        for (let x = c - R; x <= c + R + 3; x += 3) {
          const y =
            baseY +
            Math.sin(x * k + phase * speed + j * 1.7) * amp +
            Math.sin(x * k * 2.3 - phase * 2.1 + j) * amp * 0.35;
          ctx!.lineTo(x, y);
        }
        ctx!.lineTo(c + R, c + R);
        ctx!.closePath();
        ctx!.fillStyle = fill;
        ctx!.fill();
        if (j === 0) {
          // Light catching the surface.
          ctx!.strokeStyle = `rgba(160,208,250,${0.3 + level * 0.45})`;
          ctx!.lineWidth = 1.4;
          ctx!.stroke();
        }
      });

      // Glassy sheen so it reads as a sphere, not a flat disc.
      const sheen = ctx!.createRadialGradient(c - R * 0.4, c - R * 0.5, 0, c - R * 0.4, c - R * 0.5, R * 1.1);
      sheen.addColorStop(0, "rgba(190,225,255,0.16)");
      sheen.addColorStop(1, "rgba(190,225,255,0)");
      ctx!.fillStyle = sheen;
      ctx!.fillRect(c - R, c - R, R * 2, R * 2);
      ctx!.restore();

      ctx!.strokeStyle = `rgba(${RIPPLE},${0.45 + level * 0.3})`;
      ctx!.lineWidth = 1.3;
      ctx!.beginPath();
      ctx!.arc(c, c, R, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx!.stroke();

      if (!reduceMotion) raf = requestAnimationFrame(frame);
    }

    // With reduced motion this draws a single still frame.
    raf = requestAnimationFrame(frame);
    return () => cancelAnimationFrame(raf);
  }, [size]);

  return (
    <canvas
      ref={canvasRef}
      aria-hidden
      className="max-w-full"
      style={{ width: size, height: size, aspectRatio: "1" }}
    />
  );
}
```

```typescript
"use client";

import { useEffect, useRef } from "react";

const BARS = 61;
const COLOR = "232,240,255";

/**
 * The interviewer's voice, Siri-style: a row of thin vertical slivers, tallest
 * in the middle and fading to dots at the edges. They surge while `speaking`
 * and settle to a faint shimmer while listening.
 */
export function VoiceWave({
  speaking,
  width = 400,
  height = 190,
}: {
  speaking: boolean;
  width?: number;
  height?: number;
}) {
  const canvasRef = useRef<HTMLCanvasElement>(null);
  const speakingRef = useRef(speaking);

  useEffect(() => {
    speakingRef.current = speaking;
  }, [speaking]);

  useEffect(() => {
    const canvas = canvasRef.current;
    const ctx = canvas?.getContext("2d");
    if (!canvas || !ctx) return;

    const reduceMotion = window.matchMedia("(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)").matches;
    const dpr = Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio || 1, 2);
    canvas.width = width * dpr;
    canvas.height = height * dpr;

    const mid = height / 2;
    const pad = 14;
    const gap = (width - pad * 2) / (BARS - 1);
    const maxHalf = height * 0.44;
    // With reduced motion, hold a single mid-speech frame.
    let level = reduceMotion ? 0.8 : speakingRef.current ? 1 : 0;
    let raf = 0;

    function frame(now: number) {
      const t = now / 1000;
      if (!reduceMotion) level += ((speakingRef.current ? 1 : 0) - level) * 0.09;

      ctx!.setTransform(dpr, 0, 0, dpr, 0, 0);
      ctx!.clearRect(0, 0, width, height);

      for (let i = 0; i < BARS; i++) {
        const u = (i / (BARS - 1)) * 2 - 1; // -1 at the left edge, 1 at the right
        const envelope = Math.exp(-u * u * 3.2);
        // Layered sines stand in for real audio; the slow one makes syllable-like swells.
        const syllable = 0.55 + 0.45 * Math.sin(t * 3.1 + Math.sin(t * 1.3) * 2);
        const jitter =
          0.5 +
          0.3 * Math.sin(t * 11 + i * 0.9) +
          0.2 * Math.sin(t * 17.3 - i * 1.7);
        const voice = envelope * syllable * jitter * level;
        const idle = envelope * (0.035 + 0.02 * Math.sin(t * 1.6 + i * 0.35)) * (1 - level);
        const half = Math.max(0.9, (voice + idle) * maxHalf);

        ctx!.fillStyle = `rgba(${COLOR},${0.35 + 0.65 * Math.min(1, envelope + voice)})`;
        ctx!.beginPath();
        // An ellipse gives each sliver the pointed ends of the Siri wave.
        ctx!.ellipse(pad + i * gap, mid, 1.15, half, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx!.fill();
      }

      if (!reduceMotion) raf = requestAnimationFrame(frame);
    }

    raf = requestAnimationFrame(frame);
    return () => cancelAnimationFrame(raf);
  }, [width, height]);

  return (
    <canvas
      ref={canvasRef}
      aria-hidden
      className="max-w-full"
      style={{ width, height, aspectRatio: `${width} / ${height}` }}
    />
  );
}
```

```typescript
"use client";

import { useEffect, useRef } from "react";

// Ribbons of light that circle inside the orb. `orbit` and `size` are fractions
// of the orb radius; `speed` is turns of phase per second (negative = reverse).
const RIBBONS = [
  { rgb: "38,108,255", orbit: 0.42, size: 0.95, speed: 0.9, offset: 0 },
  { rgb: "56,198,255", orbit: 0.5, size: 0.7, speed: -1.25, offset: 2.1 },
  { rgb: "104,92,255", orbit: 0.36, size: 0.85, speed: 1.6, offset: 4.0 },
  { rgb: "20,70,200", orbit: 0.55, size: 1.05, speed: -0.6, offset: 1.0 },
  { rgb: "150,215,255", orbit: 0.28, size: 0.45, speed: 2.1, offset: 5.2 },
];

/**
 * The interviewer's "presence", Siri-style: a dark glass orb with ribbons of
 * blue light circling inside. While `speaking` they swirl faster, brighter and
 * wider, pulsing like syllables; while listening they drift slowly.
 */
export function VoiceOrb({ speaking, size = 300 }: { speaking: boolean; size?: number }) {
  const canvasRef = useRef<HTMLCanvasElement>(null);
  const speakingRef = useRef(speaking);

  useEffect(() => {
    speakingRef.current = speaking;
  }, [speaking]);

  useEffect(() => {
    const canvas = canvasRef.current;
    const ctx = canvas?.getContext("2d");
    if (!canvas || !ctx) return;

    const reduceMotion = window.matchMedia("(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)").matches;
    const dpr = Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio || 1, 2);
    canvas.width = size * dpr;
    canvas.height = size * dpr;

    const c = size / 2;
    const R = size * 0.37;
    // With reduced motion, hold a single mid-speech frame.
    let level = reduceMotion ? 0.7 : speakingRef.current ? 1 : 0;
    // Phase is accumulated so speeding up while speaking never makes the swirl jump.
    let phase = reduceMotion ? 2.4 : 0;
    let last = 0;
    let raf = 0;

    function frame(now: number) {
      const t = now / 1000;
      if (!reduceMotion) {
        const dt = last ? Math.min(0.05, (now - last) / 1000) : 0.016;
        last = now;
        level += ((speakingRef.current ? 1 : 0) - level) * 0.07;
        phase += dt * (0.45 + level * 1.5);
      }
      // Syllable-like swell so speech doesn't look like a steady spin.
      const swell = 1 + level * 0.22 * Math.sin(t * 7.3 + Math.sin(t * 2.1) * 2);

      ctx!.setTransform(dpr, 0, 0, dpr, 0, 0);
      ctx!.clearRect(0, 0, size, size);

      // Glow around the orb.
      const glow = ctx!.createRadialGradient(c, c, R * 0.7, c, c, size / 2);
      glow.addColorStop(0, `rgba(40,110,255,${0.14 + level * 0.2})`);
      glow.addColorStop(1, "rgba(40,110,255,0)");
      ctx!.fillStyle = glow;
      ctx!.fillRect(0, 0, size, size);

      ctx!.save();
      ctx!.beginPath();
      ctx!.arc(c, c, R, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx!.clip();
      ctx!.fillStyle = "#040818";
      ctx!.fillRect(c - R, c - R, R * 2, R * 2);

      // Overlapping ribbons add up to brighter light where they cross.
      ctx!.globalCompositeOperation = "lighter";
      RIBBONS.forEach((ribbon, i) => {
        const angle = phase * ribbon.speed + ribbon.offset;
        const orbit = R * ribbon.orbit * (0.55 + 0.45 * level) * (1 + 0.18 * Math.sin(phase * 1.7 + i));
        const radius = R * ribbon.size * (0.75 + 0.25 * level) * swell;
        const alpha = 0.3 + 0.6 * level;

        ctx!.save();
        ctx!.translate(c + Math.cos(angle) * orbit, c + Math.sin(angle) * orbit);
        // Stretch along the direction of travel so each blob reads as a ribbon.
        ctx!.rotate(angle + Math.PI / 2);
        ctx!.scale(1.55, 0.7);
        const light = ctx!.createRadialGradient(0, 0, 0, 0, 0, radius);
        light.addColorStop(0, `rgba(${ribbon.rgb},${alpha})`);
        light.addColorStop(0.5, `rgba(${ribbon.rgb},${alpha * 0.35})`);
        light.addColorStop(1, `rgba(${ribbon.rgb},0)`);
        ctx!.fillStyle = light;
        ctx!.beginPath();
        ctx!.arc(0, 0, radius, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx!.fill();
        ctx!.restore();
      });
      ctx!.globalCompositeOperation = "source-over";

      // Darken toward the rim so it reads as a sphere of glass.
      const shade = ctx!.createRadialGradient(c, c, R * 0.45, c, c, R);
      shade.addColorStop(0, "rgba(4,8,24,0)");
      shade.addColorStop(1, "rgba(4,8,24,0.78)");
      ctx!.fillStyle = shade;
      ctx!.fillRect(c - R, c - R, R * 2, R * 2);
      ctx!.restore();

      ctx!.strokeStyle = `rgba(110,165,255,${0.35 + level * 0.35})`;
      ctx!.lineWidth = 1.2;
      ctx!.beginPath();
      ctx!.arc(c, c, R, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx!.stroke();

      if (!reduceMotion) raf = requestAnimationFrame(frame);
    }

    raf = requestAnimationFrame(frame);
    return () => cancelAnimationFrame(raf);
  }, [size]);

  return (
    <canvas
      ref={canvasRef}
      aria-hidden
      className="max-w-full"
      style={{ width: size, height: size, aspectRatio: "1" }}
    />
  );
}
```

```typescript
"use client";

import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react";

type Status = "starting" | "on" | "off" | "blocked";

function stopStream(stream: MediaStream | null) {
  stream?.getTracks().forEach((t) => t.stop());
}

async function acquire(): Promise<MediaStream | null> {
  if (!navigator.mediaDevices?.getUserMedia) return null;
  try {
    return await navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia({
      video: { width: { ideal: 640 }, aspectRatio: 16 / 9, facingMode: "user" },
      audio: false,
    });
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
}

/**
 * The candidate's own webcam, mirrored like a video call. It is a local preview
 * only: nothing is recorded or sent anywhere.
 */
export function CameraPreview() {
  const videoRef = useRef<HTMLVideoElement>(null);
  const streamRef = useRef<MediaStream | null>(null);
  const [status, setStatus] = useState<Status>("starting");

  function attach(stream: MediaStream | null) {
    streamRef.current = stream;
    if (videoRef.current) videoRef.current.srcObject = stream;
    setStatus(stream ? "on" : "blocked");
  }

  useEffect(() => {
    let cancelled = false;
    acquire().then((stream) => {
      // The effect can be torn down before the permission prompt is answered.
      if (cancelled) stopStream(stream);
      else attach(stream);
    });
    return () => {
      cancelled = true;
      stopStream(streamRef.current);
      streamRef.current = null;
    };
  }, []);

  function turnOff() {
    stopStream(streamRef.current);
    streamRef.current = null;
    if (videoRef.current) videoRef.current.srcObject = null;
    setStatus("off");
  }

  function turnOn() {
    setStatus("starting");
    acquire().then(attach);
  }

  return (
    <div className="relative aspect-video w-full overflow-hidden rounded-xl border border-zinc-800 bg-zinc-900">
      <video
        ref={videoRef}
        autoPlay
        playsInline
        muted
        aria-label="Your camera"
        className={`h-full w-full -scale-x-100 object-cover ${status === "on" ? "" : "invisible"}`}
      />

      {status !== "on" && (
        <div className="absolute inset-0 flex flex-col items-center justify-center gap-2 px-4 text-center">
          <p className="text-sm text-zinc-400">
            {status === "starting" && "Starting camera…"}
            {status === "off" && "Camera is off"}
            {status === "blocked" && "Camera unavailable. Allow access in your browser to see yourself."}
          </p>
          {status !== "starting" && (
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={turnOn}
              className="rounded-md border border-zinc-700 px-3 py-1 text-xs text-zinc-200 hover:border-zinc-500"
            >
              {status === "blocked" ? "Try again" : "Turn on camera"}
            </button>
          )}
        </div>
      )}

      <span className="absolute bottom-2 left-2 rounded bg-black/60 px-2 py-0.5 text-xs text-zinc-200">
        You
      </span>
      {status === "on" && (
        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={turnOff}
          className="absolute bottom-2 right-2 rounded bg-black/60 px-2 py-0.5 text-xs text-zinc-200 hover:bg-black/80"
        >
          Turn off
        </button>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

```

```typescript
"use client";

import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import type { Tone, TranscriptEntry } from "@/lib/types";
import { VOICES } from "@/lib/voices";
import { VoiceOrb } from "@/components/VoiceOrb";
import { VadIndicator } from "@/components/VadIndicator";

// Rough speaking time for a line until real TTS playback drives this (milestone 3).
const MS_PER_CHAR = 55;
const MIN_SPEAK_MS = 1500;
const MAX_SPEAK_MS = 12000;

/**
 * True while the interviewer's newest line is "being said". Lines that were
 * already in the transcript when the page loaded don't replay.
 */
function useInterviewerSpeaking(transcript: TranscriptEntry[], startedAt: number) {
  const [speakingIndex, setSpeakingIndex] = useState(-1);
  const lastIndex = transcript.length - 1;
  const last = transcript[lastIndex];

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!last || last.role !== "interviewer") return;
    const duration = Math.min(MAX_SPEAK_MS, Math.max(MIN_SPEAK_MS, last.text.length * MS_PER_CHAR));
    const remaining = duration - (Date.now() - (startedAt + last.at));
    if (remaining <= 0) return;
    const on = setTimeout(() => setSpeakingIndex(lastIndex), 0);
    const off = setTimeout(() => setSpeakingIndex(-1), remaining);
    return () => {
      clearTimeout(on);
      clearTimeout(off);
    };
  }, [last, lastIndex, startedAt]);

  return speakingIndex === lastIndex && lastIndex >= 0;
}

/** The interviewer's side of the call: the voice orb, who they are, and what the mic is doing. */
export function InterviewerPanel({
  voiceId,
  tone,
  transcript,
  startedAt,
}: {
  voiceId: string;
  tone: Tone;
  transcript: TranscriptEntry[];
  startedAt: number;
}) {
  const speaking = useInterviewerSpeaking(transcript, startedAt);
  const name = VOICES.find((v) => v.id === voiceId)?.name ?? "Interviewer";

  return (
    <div className="interviewer-pop flex flex-col items-center px-4 pb-4 pt-2">
      <VoiceOrb speaking={speaking} size={200} />
      <p className="-mt-2 font-medium text-zinc-100">{name}</p>
      <p className="text-xs text-zinc-500">{tone} interviewer</p>
      <div className="mt-3">
        {/* The mic is always on with VAD. Wired up in milestone 3. */}
        <VadIndicator state={speaking ? "interviewer" : "idle"} />
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

```typescript
"use client";

import { useRef, useState } from "react";

const KEY_STEP = 24;
// Movement below this counts as a click, not a drag.
const CLICK_SLOP = 4;

/**
 * A vertical divider you drag sideways to resize the panels beside it.
 * `onDrag` gets the horizontal distance from where the drag began, so the
 * parent should remember its starting width in `onDragStart`. Arrow keys nudge
 * it too. Pass `children` to render it as a wider tab (e.g. a collapsed panel).
 */
export function ResizeHandle({
  label,
  onDragStart,
  onDrag,
  onClick,
  className = "",
  children,
}: {
  label: string;
  onDragStart: () => void;
  onDrag: (dx: number) => void;
  onClick?: () => void;
  className?: string;
  children?: React.ReactNode;
}) {
  const startX = useRef(0);
  const moved = useRef(false);
  const [dragging, setDragging] = useState(false);

  return (
    <div
      role="separator"
      aria-orientation="vertical"
      aria-label={label}
      tabIndex={0}
      onPointerDown={(e) => {
        e.currentTarget.setPointerCapture(e.pointerId);
        startX.current = e.clientX;
        moved.current = false;
        setDragging(true);
        onDragStart();
      }}
      onPointerMove={(e) => {
        if (!dragging) return;
        const dx = e.clientX - startX.current;
        if (Math.abs(dx) > CLICK_SLOP) moved.current = true;
        if (moved.current) onDrag(dx);
      }}
      onPointerUp={() => {
        if (!dragging) return;
        setDragging(false);
        if (!moved.current) onClick?.();
      }}
      onPointerCancel={() => setDragging(false)}
      onKeyDown={(e) => {
        if (e.key === "ArrowLeft" || e.key === "ArrowRight") {
          e.preventDefault();
          onDragStart();
          onDrag(e.key === "ArrowLeft" ? -KEY_STEP : KEY_STEP);
        } else if ((e.key === "Enter" || e.key === " ") && onClick) {
          e.preventDefault();
          onClick();
        }
      }}
      className={`group relative hidden shrink-0 cursor-col-resize touch-none select-none outline-none lg:flex ${className}`}
    >
      {children ?? (
        <span
          className={`mx-auto h-full w-px transition-all group-hover:w-[3px] group-hover:bg-emerald-400 group-focus-visible:w-[3px] group-focus-visible:bg-emerald-400 ${
            dragging ? "w-[3px] bg-emerald-400" : "bg-zinc-800"
          }`}
        />
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

```

_**Agent (claude-opus-5-5 2026-10-10 21:27:04Z)**_

The camera is now a smaller box inset in the bottom-left corner, all three panels can be resized, and the interviewer can be hidden and brought back. I tested the dragging and hiding in the browser with simulated drags, and typecheck and lint pass.

- **Camera:** it is capped at 230px wide and sits inside the problem panel with padding, so it no longer runs edge to edge. Your camera feed showed up live in my test.
- **Resizing:** there is a divider between the problem and the editor, and another between the editor and the interviewer. Drag either one sideways, and the editor takes whatever space is left. The dividers highlight blue on hover. Arrow keys also nudge them when focused.
- **Hiding the interviewer:** click "Hide ›" at the top right of the interviewer panel, or drag its divider far to the right until it snaps shut. The editor then fills the space.
- **Bringing it back:** a slim "‹ Interviewer" tab stays on the right edge. Click it to restore the panel at its previous width, or drag it left to pull the panel out to the width you want.

Things to know:
- Panel widths and the hidden state reset on page reload. I can save them in the browser if you want them remembered.
- The interviewer stays active while hidden, so the transcript keeps collecting.
- Resizing and hiding are desktop-only. On narrow screens the panels stack as before.
- In development, Next's round "N" badge sits over the camera's "You" label. That badge doesn't appear in a production build.

The new component is `components/ResizeHandle.tsx`; the layout changes are in `components/InterviewRoom.tsx`.
